items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: the first song after intermission was a song of Neal Hefti’s called “Dinner with Friends”

ctx.x: The band refused to play for him. And Basie died. And he was looking at him like “I told you.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

There was a time in Chicago when we played, it was a Birdland show, we played at the opera house, and the concert started at 8:00. And I’d had company that afternoon at the hotel, and at 8:00 I was just waking up, and the band was playing, no Frank Foster. So I hurriedly got dressed and called a taxi down to the theater, and I had got there just in time to miss the first half.
